_comment: SEED DEFINITIONS for native catalogue product rows, consumed by scripts/seed_native_catalog.py.
These are the product pages that mount <ProductBuyBox> but have NO catalogue row yet, so their
checkout still falls back to the shared retired placeholder. Give each a REAL priceMinor (integer
PAISE: ₹899 = 89900) and run the seed script with staff Cognito auth to create the rows, then
paste the returned productId/variantId into src/config/productCheckout.ts PRODUCT_CHECKOUT.
anew is NOT listed here: it already has a real catalogue row and is wired up in productCheckout.ts.
A product is created as status:draft with channels OFF. To make it buyable + visible you then
PATCH status:active + an approved catalogImageKey (a *-4096.png under wd-catalog-live/) +
websiteEnabled:true. The seed script can do create-only, or create+activate when --activate is
passed AND catalogImageKey is set for the product.
